title: (Vuṭṭhāna-kallita-)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || 4 Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo || || [page 274] 274 {JHĀNA-SAṂYUTTA} [XXXIV. 28. 5-7 5-7 Samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusalo || || Neva samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhanakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo || || Samādhismim vuṭṭhānakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo ca || || 8-9 Tatra bhikkhave yvāyam jhāyī || pa || uttamo ca pavaro cāti || ||
